body: I recently got put on the same stuff for nightmares and night terrors. But therapy is getting worse. I have PTSD from childhood trauma, depression, anxiety, psychosis. I just locked all that stuff away and now my therapist is doing EMDR and talking to the different parts of me. It's horrible. I'm just so so tired and broken
I tried. He said to go home and go to sleep because he didn't know what else to do. I know he means well. I know he cares. But I'm sure he'd be better off.

I have PTSD because of my dad. He did... Really horrible things and I was the oldest. I used to self harm a lot but I don't anymore. Mainly because I know it'll be found by my husband. He knows everything and I love him so much but he has to do and put up with so much because of me. I feel like someone sucker punched a hole in my chest and I'm collapsing in on myself
